places.name: Campus Library
places.description: Quiet floors, plenty of outlets, printing, and group study rooms you can reserve.

places.name: Pitts Dining Hall
places.description: Main all-you-care-to-eat dining hall. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner on weekdays; brunch on weekends.

places.name: The Hill Grill & Bistro
places.description: Burgers, sandwiches, and grab-and-go meals. Good for a quick bite between classes.

places.name: Starbucks
places.description: Coffee and snacks. Busy before 9 AM; quieter in the evening block.

places.name: Main Academic Building
places.description: General classrooms and faculty offices. Lounge seating on the first floor.

places.name: Science Building
places.description: Labs and lecture halls for biology, chemistry, and physics.

places.name: Main Quad
places.description: Outdoor benches and shade trees. Good for studying on nice days; no outlets.

places.name: Residence Hall
places.description: First-year housing with a 24-hour study lounge on the ground floor.

places.name: Athletic Complex
places.description: Gym, fitness center, and home games. Check posted hours for open gym.

places.name: Student Parking — West Lot
places.description: Commuter and resident parking. A permit is required on weekdays.
